Acme Corp Q2 2026 Earnings Call

Operator: Good morning and welcome to the Acme Corp second quarter 2026 earnings call.

Jane Smith — Chief Executive Officer: Thank you all for joining. Revenue for the quarter was $110 million, up from $100 million a year ago. Net income was $20 million. We are pleased with these results and expect continued momentum into the second half of the year.

Bob Lee — Chief Financial Officer: To add some detail, gross margin came in at 45%, and we are guiding full-year revenue to approximately $460 million.

Operator: We will now begin the question-and-answer session.

Analyst One: Can you comment on the drivers of revenue growth this quarter?

Jane Smith: Sure. Growth was primarily driven by strong demand in our core enterprise segment, along with the expansion into three new regional markets.

Analyst Two: What are the key risks you are watching for the back half of the year?

Bob Lee: We are watching foreign exchange headwinds and potential softness in discretionary enterprise spending as the main risks.
